title: Solar Inverter Loss Summary Transfer
goal: Read inverter production CSV data with periodic missing readings and curtailment flags, identify downtime and curtailed-generation intervals per inverter, and generate a summary CSV with interval timing, estimated lost kWh based on neighboring valid samples, and a categorical root-cause label.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same core skill into an energy setting where the essential work is CSV ingestion, gap-aware handling of missing readings, interval aggregation, derived metric calculation, and structured CSV export without needing any other shipped skill.
